b_except_a as (

all_records as (

    union all

    select

        false as in_a,
        true as in_b
    from b_except_a

),

summary_stats as (

    select

        in_b,
        count(*) as count

    from all_records
    group by 1, 2

),

final as (

    select

        *,
        round(100.0 * count / sum(count) over (), 2) as percent_of_total

    from summary_stats
    order by in_a desc, in_b desc

)

FROM PROD.PROD_SCHEMA.stg_token_transfers t

t.date, 
t.token_address

t.token_address,     --specific kind of stablecoins (USDT and USDC here)
s.type, 
s.symbol,

  LEFT JOIN seeds.PROD_SCHEMA_static.Stablecoins s
    ON t.token_address = s.contract_address

WHERE s.contract_address IS NOT NULL

s.type, 
s.symbol

WITH  __dbt__cte__token_transfers_agg as (
  

select 
transaction_hash, 
COUNT(*) AS token_transfer_count
from PROD.PROD_SCHEMA.stg_token_transfers
group by 1
), token_transfer_aggs AS (
select 
    transaction_hash, 
    COUNT(*) AS token_transfer_count
from PROD.PROD_SCHEMA.stg_token_transfers
group by 1
), 

transactions_enriched AS (
SELECT 
t.hash, 
t.block_number, 
t.date, 
t.from_address, 
t.to_address, 
t.value, 
t.receipt_contract_address, 
t.input, 
token_transfer_count, 
CASE 
    WHEN t.receipt_contract_address != '' THEN 'contract_creation'
    WHEN tt.transaction_hash IS NOT NULL THEN 'token_transfer'
    WHEN t.input = '0x' AND t.value > 0 THEN 'plain_eth_transfer'
    ELSE 'other'
END AS transaction_category
FROM PROD.PROD_SCHEMA.stg_transactions t
LEFT JOIN token_transfer_aggs tt 
    /*
    __dbt__cte__token_transfers_agg tt       --'ephemeral' model
    */
ON t.hash = tt.transaction_hash



where date >= (select max(date) from PROD.PROD_SCHEMA.stg_transactions_enriched)


)

SELECT *
FROM transactions_enriched
